# Tool catalog

This file is **generated from the tool registry** (ADR-0043): every row is derived from the corresponding `tool.ts`'s `def.name` and `def.summary`. Do not hand-edit it — run `bun scripts/gen-catalog.ts`, and `bun run check` enforces that it stays current.

The same list is available live from the discovery CLI: `bun wb.ts` lists every tool from the live registry, `bun wb.ts <tool>` shows one tool's schema / examples / invariants, and `bun wb.ts search` filters by type. Per-tool detail (input/output schemas, algorithm, refusal envelope) lives in `tools/<name>/README.md` — each row links out.

55 tools.

| tool | summary |
|---|---|
| [`alg-num-arith`](../tools/alg-num-arith/README.md) | Symbolic field arithmetic over named algebraic numbers (`Root[poly, k]`, ADR-0018) via Sylvester-Bareiss resultants; add/sub/mul/div/neg/inv/eq; bit-identical cross-platform forever |
| [`cas-diff`](../tools/cas-diff/README.md) | Symbolic differentiation over the closed elementary + special-function vocabulary (ADR-0023; 38 heads); DLMF-cited chain-rule rules for the Gamma, Bessel, Erf, Fresnel, ExpIntegral, Hermite and Polylog families |
| [`cas-simplify`](../tools/cas-simplify/README.md) | Symbolic canonicalisation over `Q[x_1,…,x_n]` / `Q(x_1,…,x_n)`; rational functions reduced by polynomial GCD; foreign subtrees wrapped in `tagged "cas-simplify/out-of-scope"` |
| [`cas-verify`](../tools/cas-verify/README.md) | Decide A = B over `Q(x)` by cross-multiplication; emits `lhs − rhs` as a witness on inequality |
| [`choi-iso`](../tools/choi-iso/README.md) | Choi-Jamiołkowski isomorphism between superoperator matrices and Choi matrices; pure index permutation (Watrous / QuTiP convention); bit-identical round-trip is the decisive invariant. qinfo v0.1 (ADR-0034) |
| [`cone-solve`](../tools/cone-solve/README.md) | Universal-primary tool of the convex-cone solver tier (ADR-0030) — the symbol for any convex cone program. Wraps cone-core's SCS operator-splitting substrate; five-class `status` discriminant; `numerical: true` |
| [`entropy-source`](../tools/entropy-source/README.md) | The workbench's only nondeterministic tool (`nondeterministic: true`; ADR-0005); auditable OS-randomness bridge via Web Crypto |
| [`expr-parse`](../tools/expr-parse/README.md) | Text → AST; operators `+ − * / ^`, identifiers, integer / rational / decimal literals |
| [`fidelity`](../tools/fidelity/README.md) | Uhlmann fidelity `F(ρ,σ) = (tr √(√ρ·σ·√ρ))²` between two complex Hermitian density operators (Uhlmann 1976; Jozsa 1994); surfaces `√F` and the Bures angle. Fourth qinfo v0.2 tool |
| [`groebner-basis`](../tools/groebner-basis/README.md) | Multivariate Gröbner basis over Q for `lex` and `degrevlex` orders; Buchberger 1965 + sloppy sugar + Gebauer-Möller pruning + full inter-reduction to the unique reduced GB. Symbolic tier |
| [`hypergeometric-pfq`](../tools/hypergeometric-pfq/README.md) | Arbitrary-precision `pFq(a; b; z)` via direct power series with cancellation-driven precision retry; `arbprec: true` — bit-identical cross-platform forever given `--precision=N` |
| [`integrate-1d`](../tools/integrate-1d/README.md) | Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod G7K15 quadrature (QUADPACK-style) for the closed elementary vocabulary; agent-honest `converged` field |
| [`integrate-ode-ivp`](../tools/integrate-ode-ivp/README.md) | Dormand-Prince 5(4) adaptive non-stiff IVP solver (SciPy `RK45` algorithm); agent-honest residual + step counts |
| [`integrate-ode-stiff`](../tools/integrate-ode-stiff/README.md) | Radau-IIA(5) adaptive stiff IVP solver with symbolic Jacobian auto-derivation (SciPy `Radau` algorithm); L-stable, agent-honest bookkeeping |
| [`integrate-ode-symplectic`](../tools/integrate-ode-symplectic/README.md) | Velocity Verlet / Yoshida-4 symplectic integrator for separable Hamiltonians; energy drift bounded `O(h^p)` regardless of horizon |
| [`linalg-eigh`](../tools/linalg-eigh/README.md) | Cyclic Jacobi symmetric eigensolver for real symmetric `n × n` A; agent-honest reconstruction + orthogonality errors |
| [`linalg-eigh-complex`](../tools/linalg-eigh-complex/README.md) | Hermitian eigendecomposition `H = Q·diag(λ)·Q†` for complex Hermitian H via the real-symplectic embedding (Goedecker 1999) composed with real cyclic-Jacobi eigh. ADR-0035 phase 1 |
| [`linalg-qr`](../tools/linalg-qr/README.md) | Householder QR for real `m × n`; `O(ε)` orthogonality independent of `κ(A)`; agent-honest error scalars |
| [`linalg-solve`](../tools/linalg-solve/README.md) | LU with partial pivoting + iterative refinement for `Ax = b`; agent-honest residual / condition / growth-factor / warnings |
| [`linalg-svd`](../tools/linalg-svd/README.md) | Dual-algorithm SVD (one-sided Jacobi ≤ n=500; Golub-Reinsch above); `condition_number` and `rank_estimate` are first-class fields |
| [`linalg-svd-complex`](../tools/linalg-svd-complex/README.md) | Singular value decomposition `M = U·diag(S)·V†` of a complex `m × n` matrix via complex one-sided Jacobi (Forsythe-Henrici → Drmač); supports rectangular inputs. ADR-0035 phase 2 |
| [`linsolve-q`](../tools/linsolve-q/README.md) | Exact linear solving `A·x = b` over Q via Bareiss fraction-free Gaussian elimination; distinguishes unique / under-determined / inconsistent; bit-identical cross-platform forever |
| [`lp-solve`](../tools/lp-solve/README.md) | LP specialist of the cone-solver tier (ADR-0030). Three lanes share one wire: `--method=exact` rational simplex, `--method=ipm` Mehrotra predictor-corrector, `--method=hsde-lp` homogeneous self-dual embedding |
| [`meijer-g`](../tools/meijer-g/README.md) | Top-level Meijer G dispatcher; cost-ascending dispatch (symbolic → Slater → contour → asymptotic) with honest refusal; `arbprec: true` |
| [`meijer-g-asymptotic-only`](../tools/meijer-g-asymptotic-only/README.md) | Braaksma far-field asymptotic for Meijer G in the principal sector; superasymptotic truncation at the optimal term; `arbprec: true` |
| [`meijer-g-slater-only`](../tools/meijer-g-slater-only/README.md) | Slater residue-summation path (Series 1 + Series 2) for the Meijer G-function; deterministic odd-coefficient perturbation for parameter coalescence; `arbprec: true` |
| [`meijer-g-symbolic-only`](../tools/meijer-g-symbolic-only/README.md) | Adamchik-Marichev + Roach pattern-table dispatcher for Meijer G closed-form reductions (Bateman + DLMF §16.17–18); ≥30 verified rules |
| [`mod-inv`](../tools/mod-inv/README.md) | Modular inverse via extended Euclid; `inverse` present iff invertible, `gcd` always present |
| [`mod-pow`](../tools/mod-pow/README.md) | Modular exponentiation over `Z/mZ` via square-and-multiply; canonical residue in `[0, m)` |
| [`ntt`](../tools/ntt/README.md) | Number-Theoretic Transform over `F_p`; Cooley-Tukey (power-of-two) or Bluestein chirp-z (arbitrary `n \| p−1`) |
| [`optimize-lbfgs-projected`](../tools/optimize-lbfgs-projected/README.md) | L-BFGS with active-set projection and More-Thuente line search for box-constrained minimisation; agent-honest `success` + convergence taxonomy |
| [`oracle`](../tools/oracle/README.md) | Golden-master harness; modes `exact` (default) and `structural`; exits 1 on any failure |
| [`partial-trace`](../tools/partial-trace/README.md) | Trace out one or more subsystems of an operator on a tensor-product Hilbert space (dims-generalised; qubit 0 = leftmost). `Tr_1(A⊗B) = tr(B)·A` is the decisive invariant. qinfo v0.1 (ADR-0034) |
| [`partial-transpose`](../tools/partial-transpose/README.md) | Transpose on selected subsystems of an operator on a tensor-product Hilbert space; the Peres-Horodecki PPT entanglement witness building block; involution `PT_S(PT_S(M)) = M`. qinfo v0.1 (ADR-0034) |
| [`poly-factor`](../tools/poly-factor/README.md) | Exact univariate factorisation over Q via Berlekamp-Zassenhaus; output canonical (irreducible, primitive, positive-leading, sorted) |
| [`poly-roots`](../tools/poly-roots/README.md) | Symbolic roots of univariate polynomials over Q; closed-form radicals for deg ≤ 4, `Root[poly, k]` for real roots of deg ≥ 5 |
| [`purity`](../tools/purity/README.md) | Purity `γ(ρ) = tr(ρ²)` of a complex Hermitian density operator via the one-pass entrywise identity `γ = Σ \|ρ_ij\|²`; O(n²), no eigendecomposition. Second qinfo v0.2 tool |
| [`real-root-isolate`](../tools/real-root-isolate/README.md) | Rational isolating intervals for real roots via VAS continued fractions + LMQ bound; open `(lo,hi)` or singleton `(r,r)` per root |
| [`registry-list`](../tools/registry-list/README.md) | Discover all installed tools; schemas in the output are wire-encoded |
| [`registry-search`](../tools/registry-search/README.md) | Filter the registry by schema-derived predicates (input_kind / output_kind / head / name_substring, AND-conjoined); the planner-friendly discovery path |
| [`sdp-solve`](../tools/sdp-solve/README.md) | SDP specialist of the cone-solver tier (ADR-0030). Wraps solver-ipm's primal-dual interior-point method with four search-direction lanes; default `auto` routes to HSDE-NT; strict-Mosek √2-scaled wire |
| [`solve`](../tools/solve/README.md) | Top-level `Solve[]`-class dispatcher; routes across linear (Bareiss), univariate-poly (radicals + Root[]), multivariate-zero-dim (Buchberger + FGLM) and transcendental lanes; branch-honest by design |
| [`special-eval`](../tools/special-eval/README.md) | Per-head arb-prec / float64 evaluator umbrella for the Erf, Bessel and 16-head Gamma families (real + complex); one `--head=<name>` flag dispatches across heads and {float64, arb-prec} tiers. `arbprec: true` |
| [`sturm-controlled`](../tools/sturm-controlled/README.md) | Sturm channel combinator: prepends a control wire to every `ry`/`rz` in the body; refuses on `prepare`/`observe`/`oracle`/`discard` or wire-id collision |
| [`sturm-equivalent`](../tools/sturm-equivalent/README.md) | Decide whether two Sturm channels denote the same arrow via canonical-form comparison + distribution comparison; sound on equal and on witness-backed inequality |
| [`sturm-execute`](../tools/sturm-execute/README.md) | Pure-analytic state-vector simulation of a Sturm circuit; `tagged "sturm-execute/out-of-scope"` for oracle / discard / qubit-cap > 12 / free-symbolic angles |
| [`sturm-find`](../tools/sturm-find/README.md) | Grover's algorithm via `sturm-execute` + optional `sturm-sample`; v0.1 caps at `n_bits ≤ 3` |
| [`sturm-sample`](../tools/sturm-sample/README.md) | Born's rule sampling: walks the Born CDF using 8 bytes per shot; strictly deterministic given entropy |
| [`sturm-simplify`](../tools/sturm-simplify/README.md) | Idempotent Sturm channel IR canonicaliser; eliminates trivial rotations, fuses same-axis adjacencies, sorts/dedupes controls |
| [`sturm-tensor`](../tools/sturm-tensor/README.md) | Sturm channel combinator: parallel composition (monoidal product); wire-id-renamed right concatenated onto left verbatim |
| [`sturm-then`](../tools/sturm-then/README.md) | Sturm channel combinator: sequential composition `f; g`; positional wire renaming at the boundary; length/kind/dim mismatch → boundary tag |
| [`sturm-trace`](../tools/sturm-trace/README.md) | TS-native frontend tool: run a TypeScript source string that builds a channel via `@workbench/sturm`'s `trace(...)` DSL (ADR-0009) in a sandboxed Bun subprocess, emit the canonical IR Value |
| [`tensor-product`](../tools/tensor-product/README.md) | Kronecker product `A ⊗ B` of two real matrices; the standard composable primitive for assembling operators on product spaces. Mixed-product law is the decisive invariant. qinfo v0.1 (ADR-0034) |
| [`trace-distance`](../tools/trace-distance/README.md) | Trace distance `D(ρ,σ) = ½‖ρ − σ‖₁` between two complex Hermitian density operators; the operationally-meaningful state-distinguishability metric (Helstrom 1969). Third qinfo v0.2 tool |
| [`trace-norm`](../tools/trace-norm/README.md) | Schatten-1 (trace / nuclear) norm `‖M‖₁` of any square complex matrix via two-path dispatch: Hermitian → eigh-complex (`Σ\|λ_k\|`), non-Hermitian → svd-complex (`Σ S_k`). First qinfo v0.2 tool |
